text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, Trainer?! I won! It's my 
complete and total victory!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I did everything I could for today. I was 
confident, too. But when it actually came 
time to run—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how strange. My heart is still 
pounding...
choice_data_list: My heart was pounding just watching!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that's the best praise anyone could 
give♪ I'm sure it's burned into the eyes 
and memories of the fans forever.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that was a memorable race, worthy 
of adorning the title of "the strongest" 
that I will claim someday!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now, at this rate, we're going to seize 
both victory and the drama all for 
ourselves!
choice_data_list:
Let's push straight ahead like this, on 
the path to becoming the strongest!

Don't get complacent! We've still got a 
lot more training to do!

Don't let your guard down! We've still got 
so much more training to do!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'll keep climbing higher and 
higher, all the way to the top!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And one day, I want all my fans to look at 
me and think—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad I got to see Royce-chan's 
race that day! It's a memory for a 
lifetime!" ...they said♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally. No matter today's victory, if 
it doesn't continue, it will just be 
forgotten..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I'm aiming to be the 'strongest'—one 
etched into the memories of countless 
fans—I can't afford to stop here!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now, once we get back to the academy, it's 
strategy meeting time. I've gotta show 
everyone an even newer, "strongest" 
Royce-chan!
